request.query: Set of nonzero integer multivariate polynomials with bounded individual degrees and absolute coefficients

items.name: MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_degree
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  f ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ n d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ Finsupp.degree d = n

items.name: MvPolynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R), f ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.degrees_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R), (∑ i ∈ s, f i).degrees ≤ s.sup fun i => (f i).degrees

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreesLE_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R], MvPolynomial.degreesLE R σ 0 = 1

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreesLE
items.type: (R : Type u) → (σ : Type u_1) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Multiset σ → Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R
